items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: I played with his brother Marty Marcella. So I played once in a band that was gotten together and managed by Ben Pollack

ctx.x: I played with his brother Marty Marcella. So I played once in a band that was gotten together and managed by Ben Pollack, but it was under the name of Cheeple Marks, the first brothers. And in that band Marty Marcella was playing. George Wettling played drums in it. Quite a few other guys like that.
Back to Clayton Dorr, who was he playing with? Just spots? He didn't?
